description: This file defines configuration options and validation logic for Redis-based grain directory in Orleans. It includes a configuration class with properties for Redis connection, a delegate for creating Redis connections, and validation to ensure the configuration is correctly set.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectoryOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration settings for Redis grain directory, including connection options, creation delegate, and entry expiry.

classes.name: RedactRedisConfigurationOptions
classes.description: Custom attribute class for redacting sensitive Redis configuration details.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectoryOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the Redis grain directory configuration, specifically ensuring required options are provided.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Default asynchronous method to create and connect a Redis multiplexer using provided configuration options.

methods.name: Redact
methods.description: Method for redacting Redis configuration details, hiding sensitive information such as passwords.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the Redis configuration options are set; throws an exception if not.
